en.chartEmpty: No data yet. Charts appear once requests go through the proxy.
en.chartHint: Aggregated live from the in-memory log, refreshed every 5s; covers the ring buffer only (last 500 entries) and resets when the log is cleared.
en.followHintShort: Automatically follows the system proxy's port changes (within 3s); when off, forwards via the manual address below.
en.followManualNote: Address/port below are fallback only and won't change while following.
en.harnessSocks: web_fetch is not proxied (SOCKS5 unsupported by the harness layer; switch to HTTP to cover it)
en.harnessUnavailable: web_fetch is not proxied (harness proxy layer unavailable)
en.harnessUnverified: web_fetch is not proxied (harness route self-check failed)
en.logEmpty: No entries yet. Requests forwarded through the plugin appear here once the proxy is enabled.
en.logFullEvicted: Full content evicted by the pool limit
en.logFullGone: Entry evicted; full content no longer available
en.logFullTooLarge: Body exceeds 256KB; full content not kept
en.logHint: In-memory only, never written to disk. Records every request through this plugin (agent fetch and web_fetch CONNECT tunnels). TLS tunnel contents are encrypted; only the target and byte counts are recorded. Last 500 entries kept.
en.logRelayOff: not running (no web_fetch entries while off)
en.noProxyHint: Comma-separated hosts; matched hosts connect directly. Loopback excluded by default.
en.saveFailed: Save failed - check input and connection
en.subtitle: Route the agent's network requests (web search / web_fetch / external APIs) through a local proxy. Changes apply immediately.
en.sysOff: System proxy is off, forwarding via the manual address below
en.sysPac: System uses PAC; following unavailable (manual config kept)
en.sysUnavailable: Cannot read system proxy settings (manual config kept)
